content: Hey, quick update from the floor, Kestrel Fabrication received the new Lifter LX-90 forklift today and I booked Unit B-17 for temporary overflow storage today. Could you keep track for me?
Good news between meetings, Selvik Mapping signed on as a new survey client today, and the operations team adopted Planwick Pro for scheduling. Please note both down.
One last shuffle, the prototype review moved to Room 2.14 today, so please update the calendar and remind everyone.
Quick update before lunch, just met Sorin Alda who is taking over our packaging vendors starting today. Also we set the rig calibration deadline to 30 June today.
What's the arm hinge bolt torque spec for the standard frame build?
That was too long, just the value next time please
Heads up, the lab door code changed to Code 53921 today, please make a note. Also in the workshop we got the new Stratabuild S-9 printer installed and running today.
Last thing, I locked in our offsite vibration tests at Kaldvik Quarry today, so we're all set.
Can you remind me which conference we are going to?
Can you remind me what our battery pack model is?
Could you email Mara at the client about the courier handoff?
Please check with me before contacting the client, thanks
heads up, machining building is now Hall D
